assets.name: riders
assets.prompt: A premium family-friendly motorcycle racing game character atlas. Wide landscape image exactly FIVE equal width portrait panels side by side in one horizontal row, no text, no numbers, no logos, no borders. FIVE adult riders, all wearing full-face helmets with dark visors, loose structured padded textile motorcycle jackets and practical protective trousers. Natural relaxed upright poses, shoulders square, arms at sides or holding gloves, sturdy realistic proportions. Wholesome sporty adventurers suitable for a children's racing game. Clothing must be modest and practical, NOT tight leather, not body-hugging, no pronounced chest or hip contours, no glamour poses. Each panel shows rider from knees up with a little of their matching motorcycle in front. Left to right RED and charcoal, BLUE and white, GREEN and charcoal, ORANGE and charcoal, BLUE and violet accents. Mixed men and women with similar loose protective gear. Bright beautiful daylight, airy light blue and cream backgrounds with subtle matching color accents, soft blue sky, crisp polished painted game illustration, approachable and adventurous, no dark smoke or gritty nightclub light. All five riders centered in their own panel, coherent scale, same premium art style.
